comparison.objective: Route conduit between electrical boxes only through permitted horizontal/vertical wall zones.
comparison.physical_skill: Select and arrange conduit lengths into a compliant path, not hammer-and-mandrel force control.
comparison.success_condition: A connected L-shaped route in safe zones with no spare conduit left out of zone.
comparison.reason: The task’s core is rule-aware spatial routing; shared placement primitives are generic. No spec versions are supplied, though several gap and score examples are stated.
